SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper : 사이버상담후기*/ count(*) FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목명*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , AA.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , '1' AS NUM , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO FROM AYE100 AS AA , AYE120 AS BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND (AA.DEL_YN = 'N' OR AA.DEL_YN = 'T') AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%'
UNION SELECT BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , BB.RETE_TTL_NM /*게시글제목명*/ , BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , BB.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ , BB.RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , BB.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , '2' AS NUM , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO FROM AYE120 AS BB ,AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL
AND BB.RETE_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%'
) AS EE ORDER BY EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , EE.NUM

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 사이버상담후기(조회)*/ EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , EE.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO , CASE WHEN EE.NUM = '2' THEN 'RE: ' || EE.BBSCTT_TTL_NM ELSE EE.BBSCTT_TTL_NM END AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM , C##RG.DEC_B64(EE.CNSLTNT_NCKN) AS CNSLTNT_NCKN /* 컴슬러 닉네임 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(EE.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , EE.WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , EE.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , TO_CHAR(EE.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT , EE.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , EE.ATFINO AS ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , EE.NUM AS NUM , EE.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EE.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제상태대분류구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EE.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제원인대분류구분코드 , C##RG.DEC_B64(EE.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT , EE.CONSTT_ID FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목명*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , AA.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_NCKN , 1 AS NUM , 0 AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_ID /*상담원아이디*/ FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYA150 ZZ WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = ZZ.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = ZZ.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND ZZ.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ZZ.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT = #{CONSTT_NM_ENCPT} --상담자명 )
UNION ALL SELECT BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , BB.RETE_TTL_NM /*게시글제목명*/ , BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , BB.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , BB.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ , BB.RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , BB.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_NCKN , 2 AS NUM , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO , '' AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD , '' AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD , '' AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , '' AS CONSTT_ID /*상담원아이디*/
FROM AYE120 AS BB ,AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BB.RETE_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) < 20 THEN BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT ELSE C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) END LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYA150 ZZ WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = ZZ.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = ZZ.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND ZZ.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ZZ.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT = #{CONSTT_NM_ENCPT} --상담자명 )
) AS EE ORDER BY EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , EE.NUM OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper.selectBbsEpilogoDetail : 사이버상담후기(상세) * 2023.04.26 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글구분코드 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MM:SS') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD /* 출생일자 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소 */ , AA.CHRCTR_YN AS CHRCTR_YN /* 문자여부 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호암호화 */ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /* 조회수 */ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 아이피 */ , AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , ( SELECT REG_DT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' ) AS REG_DT /* 상담자배정일자 */ , ( SELECT CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' ) AS CONSTT_ID /* 상담자아이디 */ , ( SELECT A1.MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' ) AS MEMO_NM /* 메모 */ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별 */ , AA.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력구분코드 */ , AA.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , AA.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD AS REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN AS REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , AA.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS YNGBGS_SE_NO /* 청소년구분번호 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 문제상태중분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태소분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인소분류구분코드 */ , AA.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN /* 기타내용 */ , AA.LINK_PRCS_SE_CN AS LINK_PRCS_SE_CN /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM /* 접수의뢰경로구분명 */ , AA.LINK_INST_NM AS LINK_INST_NM /* 연계기관명 */ FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
mapper.update: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper : 사이버상담후기(수정) * 2023.04.26 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 / 컬럼 추가 - Jeong.Won.Je */ UPDATE AYE100 SET SXDC_SE_CD = #{SXDC_SE_CD} /* 성별 */ , ACBG_SE_CD = #{ACBG_SE_CD} /* 학력구분코드 */ , GRADE_SE_CD = #{GRADE_SE_CD} /* 학년구분코드 */ , GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD = #{GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD} /* 졸업상태구분코드 */ , REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD = #{REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD} /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN = #{REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN} /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , YNGBGS_SE_NO = #{YNGBGS_SE_NO} /* 청소년구분번호 */ , PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD} /* 문제상태중분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태소분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류구분코드 */ , PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인소분류구분코드 */ , ETC_CN = #{ETC_CN} /* 기타내용 */ , LINK_PRCS_SE_CN = #{LINK_PRCS_SE_CN} /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD} /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , LINK_INST_NM = #{LINK_INST_NM} /* 연계기관명 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최중수정아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일 */ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD}

UPDATE /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper.updateBbsEpilogo160 : 사이버상담후기(수정)*/ AYA160 SET MEMO_NM = #{MEMO_NM} , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}

UPDATE AYE100 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper : 사이버상담후기(삭제)*/ DEL_YN = 'Y' /*삭제여부*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' /*게시글구분유형코드*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글고유번호*/
mapper.select: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper.selectBbsEpilogoRplyDetail : 사이버상담후기(답글상세) * 2023.04.26 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 / FROM 절에 AYE100 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT T1.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(TT2.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 TT1 ,SCA100 TT2 WHERE 1=1 AND TT1.ENFSN_NO = TT2.ENFSN_NO AND TT1.USER_ID = T1.LAST_MDFR_ID ) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , T1.RETE_TTL_NM AS RETE_TTL_NM /* 답글제목명 */ , T1.RETE_CN AS RETE_CN /* 답글내용 */ , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ FROM AYE120 T1 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( T1.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR T1.DEL_YN IS NULL )
mapper.insert: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper : 사이버상담후기(답글등록) * 2023.04.26 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 - Jeong.Won.Je */ INSERT INTO AYE120 ( RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , RETE_TTL_NM /* 답글제목 */ , RETE_CN /* 답글내용 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYE120_SQ01.NEXTVAL /* 답글고유번호 */ , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /* 게시글번호 */ , #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , #{RETE_TTL_NM} /* 답글제목 */ , #{RETE_CN} /* 답글내용 */ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /* 작성자아이디 */ , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 작성자아이디 */ , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper : 사이버상담후기(답글삭제) * 2023.04.26 수정 : 데이터 삭제 ▷ DEL_YN = 'Y' 처리로 변경 / AND 조건 : 게시글고유번호 + 게시글유형구분코드 ▷ 답글고유번호 로 변경 - Jeong.Won.Je */ UPDATE AYE120 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE 1=1 AND RETE_ESNTAL_NO = #{RETE_ESNTAL_NO}
mapper.select:

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsEpilogoListMapper.selectBbsEpilogoRplyDetail2 : 사이버상담후기(답글상세)*/ AA.ATFINO /*파일번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글 고유번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피주소*/ , AA.RETE_CN /*답글내용*/ , AA.RETE_ESNTAL_NO /*답글고유번호*/ , AA.RETE_TTL_NM /*답글제목*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , AA.EML_ADDR_ENCPT /*이메일*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD) AS NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.ACBG_SE_CD) AS ACBG_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = BB.GRADE_SE_CD) AS GRADE_SE_CD , BB.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD , BB.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN FROM AYE120 AA ,AYE100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
